questions.question: More than forty men plotted to kill Paul. What did they swear not to do until he was dead?
When Paul's nephew heard about the plot to kill Paul, what did he do?

answers.text: Went into the barracks and told Paul
Went to the chief priests and pleaded

questions.question: After learning of a plot to kill Paul, a Roman commander sent him with soldiers to which ruler?
When Paul was brought to Governor Felix in Caesarea, what did Felix decide to do with him?

answers.text: Hear his case when the accusers arrive
Send him back to Jerusalem right away
Set him free since there's no charge
